zh-CN.title: 庄子（庄周）
zh-CN.subtitle: 战国思想家与复合文本传统的入口
zh-CN.shortSummary: 庄子是道家思想与寓言式哲学的重要入口；人物传记、内外篇层次和后世注疏必须保持区分。
curatorialDescription: 本馆把庄周作为历史与传统交界的人物入口，把《庄子》作为包含不同篇章层和传承层的文本，而不把全书压缩为单一作者的逐字记录。
孟城在本批次中只作为人物传统与现代地理之间的区域锚点；地图点位不证明庄周在该点的每一次活动。
zh-CN.researchNote: 生平细节和《庄子》篇章归属仍有争议；当前只发布保守的年代导航、文本入口和区域关联。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 约公元前 4 世纪；文本层有争议

en.title: Zhuangzi (Zhuang Zhou)
en.subtitle: A gateway into Warring States thought and a composite textual tradition
en.shortSummary: Zhuangzi is a major entry into Daoist thought and parabolic philosophy; biography, chapter layers and later commentary must remain distinct.
curatorialDescription: The museum treats Zhuang Zhou as a figure at the boundary of history and tradition, and the Zhuangzi as a text with different chapter and transmission layers rather than a single verbatim authorial record.
Mengcheng is used here as a regional anchor between figure tradition and modern geography; its map point does not prove every activity took place there.
en.researchNote: Biographical detail and chapter attribution remain contested; this release uses a conservative date range, text entry and regional association.
en.timeLabel: c. fourth century BCE; textual layers contested

zh-CN.title: 孟子（孟轲）
zh-CN.subtitle: 游说诸侯、性善论与儒家经典化的桥梁
zh-CN.shortSummary: 孟子把先秦游说、政治伦理与后世儒家经典化连接起来；《孟子》文本和传记层不应互相替代。
curatorialDescription: 人物入口以《史记》与《孟子》传述为边界，重点呈现游历诸侯与言说传统，而不把后世理学地位倒写为先秦现场事实。
邹城在地图中作为现代城市尺度锚点，代表人物传统的地域入口；具体行迹仍需按国家和地点分别核对。
zh-CN.researchNote: 孟子生年、游历路线和文本形成区间均需保留不确定性；当前不提供逐年旅行线。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 约公元前 4 世纪；年代导航区间

value.en: Historical person

en.title: Mencius (Meng Ke)
en.subtitle: A bridge among itinerant counsel, political ethics and Confucian canonisation
en.shortSummary: Mencius connects Warring States itinerancy, political ethics and later Confucian canonisation; the Mengzi text and biographical layer must not replace one another.
curatorialDescription: The entry uses the Shiji and transmitted Mengzi as boundaries, foregrounding counsel to rulers and traditions of speech without projecting later Neo-Confucian status into the Warring States scene.
Zoucheng is a city-scale map anchor for the regional tradition around the figure; specific itineraries require separate state- and place-level evidence.
en.researchNote: Birth dates, itinerary and textual formation remain ranges; no year-by-year travel line is asserted.
en.timeLabel: c. fourth century BCE; navigational range

value.en: Historical person

zh-CN.title: 张道陵
zh-CN.subtitle: 天师道源流中的历史人物与神圣化祖师
zh-CN.shortSummary: 张道陵是道教组织化源流的重要入口；历史人物、天师谱系和后世神圣化必须分层。
curatorialDescription: 条目把东汉人物线索与约后世形成的天师授受叙事分开，鹤鸣山只表示传统空间与后世记忆的交汇。
人物节点不把‘祖天师’的神圣称号写回为没有限定的东汉现场事实。
zh-CN.researchNote: 现存生平细节大量依赖后世传记和道教经书；当前采用低置信传统年代，并把神圣化留在接受关系中。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 传统置于东汉；约 34–156 年的导航区间

en.title: Zhang Daoling
en.subtitle: A historical figure and later sacralised founder in the Celestial Masters tradition
en.shortSummary: Zhang Daoling is a major gateway into organised Daoist origins; the historical person, Celestial Masters genealogy and later sacralisation must remain layered.
curatorialDescription: The record separates Eastern Han biographical traces from later revelation and lineage narratives; Mount Heming marks a meeting of traditional geography and later memory.
The title ‘Ancestral Celestial Master’ is not projected back as an unqualified Eastern Han field fact.
en.researchNote: Much surviving biography depends on later hagiography and Daoist scripture; this release uses a low-confidence traditional range and models sacralisation as reception.
en.timeLabel: Placed traditionally in the Eastern Han; c. 34–156 navigational range

zh-CN.title: 葛洪
zh-CN.subtitle: 《抱朴子》、神仙论述与道家—儒家交涉
zh-CN.shortSummary: 葛洪把道教修炼、方术、政治伦理和文本写作连接起来，是理解东晋道教知识生产的重要人物。
curatorialDescription: 《抱朴子》自叙和内外篇为人物与文本之间的主要入口；本馆把文本中的神仙叙述与历史事实分层。
罗浮山作为现实山地和后世道教记忆地点显示，但不把所有传说活动都投影为精确坐标。
zh-CN.researchNote: 葛洪年代和文本活动有较充分的传记与作品入口，但具体居止、炼丹实践和后世仙传仍需逐条核对。

en.title: Ge Hong
en.subtitle: The Baopuzi, transcendence discourse and Daoist–Confucian negotiation
en.shortSummary: Ge Hong connects Daoist cultivation, techniques, political ethics and textual production, offering a key entry into Eastern Jin religious knowledge.
curatorialDescription: The Baopuzi's autobiographical and inner/outer chapter layers form the main person–text gateway; its transcendence narratives are kept separate from historical claims.
Mount Luofu is shown as a real landscape and later Daoist memory site without turning every legend into a precise coordinate.
en.researchNote: Ge Hong's dates and works have strong textual entry points, while residence, technical practice and later immortal biographies require item-level review.

zh-CN.title: 阿育王
zh-CN.subtitle: 敕诏、王权与佛教传播的早期节点
zh-CN.shortSummary: 阿育王通过岩刻和石柱敕诏留下了可见的政治与宗教物证，是连接印度历史、佛教传播和遗产地图的重要人物。
curatorialDescription: 本条优先显示敕诏与遗址层，而不把后世佛教传记中复杂的阿育王故事直接当作同一时期的政治事实。
桑奇是物质遗产与后世记忆节点；阿育王并不因此被定位为在所有佛教遗址都亲自活动。
zh-CN.researchNote: 统治年代和敕诏遗址有考古/遗产资料支撑；佛教皈依、传法和舍利叙事仍需分层审核。

en.title: Ashoka
en.subtitle: Edicts, kingship and an early node in Buddhist transmission
en.shortSummary: Ashoka left visible political and religious evidence in rock and pillar edicts, making him a key figure for linking Indian history, Buddhist transmission and heritage geography.
curatorialDescription: The entry foregrounds edict and site layers rather than treating complex later Buddhist biographies of Ashoka as political facts from the same period.
Sanchi is a material-heritage and later-memory node; it does not place Ashoka personally at every Buddhist site.
en.researchNote: Reign dates and edict sites are supported by archaeological and heritage records; conversion, missions and relic narratives require separate layers.

zh-CN.title: 龙树
zh-CN.subtitle: 中观论述、空性哲学与跨区域接受
zh-CN.shortSummary: 龙树是佛教哲学史中连接中观论书写、印度思想论辩和东亚接受史的高识别度人物。
curatorialDescription: 《中论》作为作品和龙树作为人物分别建模；年代、作品归属和传记地点不被压成一个确定的生平点。
那伽朱那康达在本批次中仅作为南印度记忆/区域锚点，坐标精度低，不等同于龙树确定的居住地。
zh-CN.researchNote: 龙树年代通常置于公元 2–3 世纪之间，传记与地点存在争议；当前通过低置信时间和记忆空间进入地图网络。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 约公元 2–3 世纪；年代与地点有争议

en.title: Nāgārjuna
en.subtitle: Madhyamaka argument, emptiness and transregional reception
en.shortSummary: Nāgārjuna is a recognisable figure linking Madhyamaka writing, Indian philosophical debate and later East Asian reception.
curatorialDescription: The Mūlamadhyamakakārikā is modelled as a work distinct from Nāgārjuna as a person; dates, attribution and biographical places are not compressed into one certain life point.
Nagarjunakonda is used only as a southern Indian memory/regional anchor with low coordinate precision, not as a confirmed residence.
en.researchNote: Nāgārjuna is commonly placed in the second to third centuries CE, while biography and place traditions remain contested; this entry uses low-confidence time and memory geography.
en.timeLabel: c. second–third centuries CE; date and place contested

zh-CN.title: 鸠摩罗什
zh-CN.subtitle: 龟兹—长安译经网络与佛教汉译
zh-CN.shortSummary: 鸠摩罗什把龟兹、长安和佛教经典翻译连接起来，是跨语言知识生产与东亚佛教传播的关键人物。
curatorialDescription: 人物条目强调译场的协作性：译主、助手、校勘和制度支持不能被压成一个人的孤立写作。
龟兹与长安是两个具有不同证据层的空间节点，路线线条不表示已复原的逐日旅行。
zh-CN.researchNote: 344–413 年和约 401 年入长安有机构/传记参考；具体译经清单、团队分工和版本差异仍需逐项核对。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 344–413 年；约 401 年进入长安译经场

en.title: Kumārajīva
en.subtitle: The Kucha–Chang'an translation network and Buddhist Chinese
en.shortSummary: Kumārajīva connects Kucha, Chang'an and the translation of Buddhist scriptures, making him a key figure in multilingual knowledge production and East Asian transmission.
curatorialDescription: The entry foregrounds the collaborative translation field: lead translator, assistants, revision and institutional support are not collapsed into solitary authorship.
Kucha and Chang'an are spatial nodes with different evidence layers; the line does not claim a reconstructed day-by-day journey.
en.researchNote: 344–413 and arrival in Chang'an around 401 have institutional and biographical references; translation lists, team roles and version differences require item-level review.
en.timeLabel: 344–413 CE; translation work in Chang'an from c. 401

zh-CN.title: 法显
zh-CN.subtitle: 求法旅行、《佛国记》与海陆交通
zh-CN.shortSummary: 法显把东亚僧侣的求法旅行、印度与斯里兰卡的见闻和汉文佛教旅行记连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 《佛国记》既是旅行文本，也是观察早期佛教地点、制度和物质环境的窗口；记述视角不等同于完整实地地图。
路线采用区域锚点，不把海上回程和每个国家的停留时长伪装为同等精度。
zh-CN.researchNote: 约 399–414 年的旅行范围和文本活动可作为入口；生卒、具体路线与地点对应仍需旅行记版本和历史地理互证。

Chang'an–South Asia–maritime return

en.title: Faxian
en.subtitle: Pilgrimage, the Foguoji and maritime–overland movement
en.shortSummary: Faxian connects a monastic pilgrimage from East Asia with observations of India and Sri Lanka and a Chinese Buddhist travel record.
curatorialDescription: The Foguoji is both a travel text and a window onto early Buddhist places, institutions and material settings; its viewpoint is not a complete field map.
The route uses regional anchors without pretending that maritime return legs or every stay have equal precision.
en.researchNote: The c. 399–414 travel and textual horizon is a usable entry; life dates, route detail and place identifications require edition and historical-geography comparison.

zh-CN.title: 盘古
zh-CN.subtitle: 天地开辟叙事中的神话人格
zh-CN.shortSummary: 盘古进入本馆的神话宇宙入口，表示开辟与天地生成叙事，不占用历史人物的生卒年和现实坐标。
curatorialDescription: 盘古只进入神话/象征层；不同文本中的开辟叙事、身体化宇宙和后世编排不合并为一条历史事件。
zh-CN.researchNote: 当前以传统文本见证和 symbolic cosmos 呈现；没有把神话顺序换算成伪历史年代。

en.title: Pangu
en.subtitle: A mythic persona in cosmogenesis narratives
en.shortSummary: Pangu is a mythic-cosmos gateway for creation and the ordering of heaven and earth; he receives no historical lifespan or real-world coordinate.
curatorialDescription: Pangu belongs only to the mythic and symbolic layer; different cosmogenesis texts and later arrangements are not merged into one historical event.
en.researchNote: The entry uses textual witnesses and symbolic cosmos without converting mythic sequence into pseudo-historical dates.
en.timeLabel: Mythic traditional time: no historical dating

zh-CN.shortSummary: 女娲连接造人、补天、婚姻与秩序修复的多重叙事，是神话时代空间入口而非历史人物卡。
curatorialDescription: 本条区分早期文献片段、后世神话编排和地方祭祀/图像记忆；不把女娲故事的所有版本合并。
zh-CN.researchNote: 现实世界中的女娲庙、图像和地方传说可在后续 memory/cult site 批次单独加入；当前只进入象征空间。

en.title: Nüwa
en.subtitle: A mythic persona of creation, repair and restored order
en.shortSummary: Nüwa brings together stories of creating humans, repairing the sky, marriage and restoring order; she is a mythic-space entry, not a historical dossier.
curatorialDescription: The record separates early textual fragments, later mythic arrangements and local ritual/image memory rather than merging every version of the Nüwa story.
en.researchNote: Temples, images and local traditions can enter a later memory/cult-site batch; this release keeps Nüwa in symbolic space only.
en.timeLabel: Mythic traditional time: no historical dating

zh-CN.shortSummary: 伏羲连接八卦、文字/制度起源与三皇谱系，是神话时代文明原型的象征节点。

en.subtitle: A mythic sage-king of trigrams, order and civilisational origins
en.shortSummary: Fu Xi connects trigrams, the origins of writing or institutions and the Three Sovereigns genealogy as a symbolic node of mythic civilisation.
curatorialDescription: Fu Xi's images and invention narratives belong to traditional and later symbolic layers; the origin of the trigrams is not published as one verifiable historical event.
en.researchNote: Later batches may add Fu Xi–Nüwa imagery, local cults and excavated objects; this release adds no real-world activity coordinate.

en.subtitle: Five Emperors genealogy, political ancestry and later symbolism
en.shortSummary: Huangdi appears in legendary ruler genealogies, medical or Daoist lore and modern ancestry narratives; these reception layers must remain separate.
curatorialDescription: The museum first places Huangdi in symbolic cosmos: the Shiji genealogy, asking Guangchengzi about the Dao, imperial tomb memory and modern ancestry narratives are not merged.

en.title: Taishang Laojun
en.subtitle: The sacred Daoist identity formed through Laozi's later deification
en.shortSummary: Taishang Laojun is not an alias card for Laozi but a separate sacred identity for modelling Daoist sacralisation, scriptural genealogy and cosmic order.
curatorialDescription: This node connects to Laozi through a deified_as relation; celestial identity, the Three Pure Ones genealogy and later scriptures are not written back into Laozi's historical or traditional biography.
en.researchNote: The entry uses Daoist scripture and terminology as a sacralisation layer; emergence dates, textual formation and temple practice require item-level records.
